synth.notes:
Lattice: 21x21 grid of 3px blocks. A1/A2 move axis A (a wall row), A3/A4 move axis B (a wall column). A5 cycles A -> B -> pieces (ordered by min block). The selected piece moves one block in 4 directions, stays on board, and cannot overlap the other piece.
Mirrors: the visible gray reflection is the B-mirror (a,2B-b) of piece blocks. It is hidden when that piece touches row A. A- and AB-mirrors are always hidden. Mirror cells outside the undrawn 21x21 board bound are clipped (this explains the step-268 counterexample). Piece-covered destinations are skipped.
Render: hidden cells erase wall rings. Targets under a piece or any mirror cell keep only their centre pixel. A selected axis or piece shows 0 dots, and a piece hole passes a wall dot through.
Re-extraction: 4-conn comps. Wall/piece index = rank + foreign 0-dots before the comp's top-left. Reflection index = rank among visible comps + hidden-cell comps. Targets merge when the bbox gap is <=4 on both axes. Wall v/h = w>=h.
